response.final_analysis: Epinephrine, when administered in high doses, acts on various adrenergic receptors. It is well-documented to cause bronchodilation through beta-2 adrenergic receptor activation, contrary to causing bronchiolar constriction. This understanding is crucial, especially in clinical settings where epinephrine is used to manage asthma and other respiratory conditions.
